dispatch.rulesTitle: Dispatch rules are yours to write
dispatch.rulesDesc: This page only writes the files dispatching needs. It never writes your global instruction files (such as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, or ~/AGENTS.md) and never writes dispatch rules for you. Decide when to dispatch and to whom, then write that into your global instruction files. Example text to copy and edit:
dispatch.rulesExample:
Dispatch rules (example)
- Delegate to an external CLI only when I explicitly select $opencode-agent or $antigravity-agent.
- State the goal, acceptance criteria, and allowed scope before delegating; I review the diff and run verification afterwards.
- Prefer $antigravity-agent for browser/desktop automation and $opencode-agent for long autonomous coding.
- Add more named workers by running $external-agent-setup in your Agent first.
